device.description: Target block device for the Plextor drive (e.g., /dev/hdc, /dev/sr3).

firmware_path.description: Path to the input firmware binary file (-if option).

force_flash.description: Enable force flashing (-f option). Dangerous if device not recognized or checksum fails.

update_mode.description: Enable update mode (-u option). Writes firmware only if checksum succeeds.

actions.description: List of additional actions to perform: 'read_eeprom', 'reboot', 'test_opcodes'. Corresponds to -e, -r, -t flags.
